findings.claim: FY2025 10-K Item 3 列示的法律程序為證券集體訴訟等；未列反壟斷調查。FTC 在 10-K 中僅以隱私與廣告消費者保護監管角色出現。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 3 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: Between August 21 and October 9, 2024, three substantially similar putative class action complaints were filed against us and certain of our executive officers in the United States District Court for the Southern District of California.

findings.claim: FTC 對一般非限制類器材（含 Dexcom）的廣告有管轄權，10-K 風險因素提示行銷內容可能遭 FDA/FTC 執法；屬產業監管框架，非已發生之調查。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: The FDA and the FTC share oversight of medical device promotion. The FDA has broad authority over device marketing (including assessment and oversight of safety and effectiveness) and over FDA-approved “promotional labeling,” while the FTC has authority over “advertising” for most medical devices (i.e., non-“restricted” devices, such as ours).

regulatory_antitrust.note: 三次搜尋未見 DOJ/FTC/EU 反壟斷調查報導。搜尋另提及 2025-03 FDA warning letter（製造與品質）與 G6/G7 消費者集體訴訟，已於 2026 10-Q 更新，但未讀到逐字原文，未列為 finding。

clues.claim: FDA 於 2025-03 對 Dexcom 發出 warning letter，指聖地牙哥與 Mesa 廠製造及品質系統不符；G6/G7 感測器未經核准變更。
